## v0.4.2-1 Release Notes

### ✨ Feature

- Minimize direct messages by clicking outside the window on desktop, or using the title-bar button on mobile. Reopen the same conversation with drafts, reply/edit state, and reading position preserved.
- Add interactive components to assistant replies, including charts, tables, calculators, decision trees, and quizzes, with a component library and per-chat selection.
- Configure time-of-day model pricing multipliers by weekday and time range, including overnight periods.

### ⚡ Optimization

- Keep message delivery, uploads, and unread updates running while direct messages are minimized, without automatically marking hidden messages as read.
- Support omitting the embedding dimensions parameter for compatible providers while retaining local vector-dimension validation.
- Show a distinct “No text” state for files without extractable content, with an explicit option to include them when rebuilding indexes.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Stop files without readable text from repeatedly re-entering the indexing pipeline.
- Preserve loaded chat history when reopening a minimized conversation, and retry interrupted initial history loads even when new messages arrive in the background.

---

## v0.4.2-1 中文版本

### ✨ Feature

- 桌面端点击私聊窗口外部即可最小化，手机端使用标题栏收起按钮；重新打开时保留当前会话、草稿、回复或编辑状态以及阅读位置。
- AI 回复新增交互式组件，支持图表、表格、计算器、决策树和测验等，提供组件库与会话内组件选择。
- 模型定价支持按星期和时间范围配置分时倍率，也支持跨午夜时段。

### ⚡ Optimization

- 私聊收起期间继续发送、上传和更新未读消息，不会自动将隐藏窗口中的消息标为已读。
- Embedding 请求支持省略维度参数，以兼容相关服务商，同时保留本地向量维度校验。
- 无可提取内容的文件显示独立的“无文本”状态，并可在重建索引时明确选择是否包含这些文件。

### 🐛 Fixed

- 修复无可读文本的文件反复进入索引处理流程的问题。
- 恢复最小化私聊时保留已加载的历史；首次历史加载中断后，即使后台收到新消息，也会重新补齐历史。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/amaoworks/DEEIX-Chat/compare/v0.4.1-5...v0.4.2-1
